# NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW — evidence not strong enough to decide

**fda:H-1099-2026** · Spring & Mulberry Inc. · 2026-01-09

> Spring & Mulberry Lavender Rose Date-Sweetened Chocolate, Net Wt. 2.1 oz. (60g), individually packaged in a light blue…

## Why
The team could not settle this: NW-100125 same — our UPC 850055470019 is printed in the notice; NW-100111 not-this — notice is about "Spring & Mulberry Lavender Rose Date-Sweetened Chocolate"; NW-100132 not-this — notice is about "Spring & Mulberry Lavender Rose Date-Sweetened Chocolate"; NW-100156 not-this — notice is about "Spring & Mulberry Lavender Rose Date-Sweetened Chocolate"; NW-100165 not-this — notice is about "Spring & Mulberry Lavender Rose Date-Sweetened Chocolate" [E8].

## What we matched
- `NW-100125` Chocolate — **same** (rule, upc): our UPC 850055470019 is printed in the notice
- `NW-100111` Mulberry Fennel Date-Sweetened Chocolate — **not-this** (judge, text): notice is about "Spring & Mulberry Lavender Rose Date-Sweetened Chocolate"
- `NW-100132` Mixed Berry Date-Sweetened Chocolate — **not-this** (judge, text): notice is about "Spring & Mulberry Lavender Rose Date-Sweetened Chocolate"
- `NW-100156` Pure Dark Date Sweetened Chocolate — **not-this** (judge, text): notice is about "Spring & Mulberry Lavender Rose Date-Sweetened Chocolate"
- `NW-100165` Date-sweetened chocolate — **not-this** (judge, text): notice is about "Spring & Mulberry Lavender Rose Date-Sweetened Chocolate"

## Actions
- Send recall notice to loyalty customers who bought affected lots since 2026-01-09: at most 95 [E14]
- Review in the queue: `npm run decide -- fda:H-1099-2026 <sku> same|not-this --note "..."`. The decision is stored in memory and used on the next run.

## Caveats
- Retailer stock, sales, lots and ship notices are synthetic (Northwind Mercantile, generated for this demo); food items are real products with real barcodes (USDA FoodData Central, Open Food Facts).
- Customer count sums weekly distinct counts, so it is an upper bound.
- Open Auditor objection: dismissed, but the quoted recalled product "Spring & Mulberry Lavender Rose Date-Sweetened Chocolate" contains every product word of our item "Date-sweetened chocolate"
